city.name: A sleepy city street
city.visual: A quiet city street with warm window lights

forest.name: An enchanted forest
forest.visual: Tall trees, floating dust, and a narrow forest path

school.name: A school after sunset
school.visual: Empty corridors lit by the last orange rays

space.name: A small space station
space.visual: A blue planet turning below a quiet observation deck

hopeful.inciting: a lost map appears in a library book
hopeful.goal: return a hidden treasure to its rightful owner
hopeful.opening: This map was waiting for us.
hopeful.obstacle: the map changes whenever they look away
hopeful.action: follows the final mark without a safety net
hopeful.turn: Being brave does not mean being certain.
hopeful.ending: The treasure is a letter reminding them that the journey was the real gift.
hopeful.final_line: We found exactly what we needed.

funny.inciting: a delivery goes to the wrong doorstep
funny.goal: solve the mistake before the real owner arrives
funny.opening: Why is there a penguin in this box?
funny.obstacle: every helpful idea makes the problem bigger
funny.action: turns the chaos into a surprisingly clever plan
funny.turn: Okay, nobody panic. Especially the penguin.
funny.ending: The mistake becomes the start of a new friendship.

emotional.inciting: an old voicemail plays at the worst possible moment
emotional.goal: recreate one perfect memory for a loved one
emotional.obstacle: nothing goes according to the carefully written plan
emotional.action: stops trying to make everything perfect
emotional.turn: Maybe perfect was never the point.
emotional.ending: A messy surprise becomes the memory they both needed.

funny.inciting: the school mascot disappears before the big event
funny.goal: find it without letting anyone discover the embarrassing truth
funny.opening: Nobody saw a six-foot chicken leave, right?
funny.obstacle: the mascot keeps turning up in increasingly public places
funny.turn: I have a plan. It is not a good plan.
funny.ending: The mascot returns just in time, wearing a tiny crown.
funny.final_line: We are never speaking of this again.

hopeful.inciting: a garden begins growing in an abandoned place
hopeful.goal: protect it from being cleared away
hopeful.obstacle: the adults only see an empty lot
hopeful.action: invites the whole neighborhood to witness it
hopeful.turn: You cannot erase what people care for.
hopeful.ending: The lot becomes a community garden.

emotional.inciting: two friends find a goodbye letter written years ago
emotional.goal: deliver it to the person who was meant to read it
emotional.opening: They were waiting all this time.
emotional.obstacle: the recipient has stopped believing old promises
emotional.action: shares the letter even though it may hurt
emotional.final_line: I am glad you came back.

mysterious.inciting: every clock in town stops at the same minute
mysterious.goal: discover what happened before time starts again
mysterious.obstacle: the only witness remembers tomorrow instead of today
mysterious.action: trusts a detail everyone else ignored
mysterious.turn: The answer was hiding in the silence.
mysterious.ending: Time moves again, but one clock remains stopped as a warning.
mysterious.final_line: Now we know when to listen.

exciting.inciting: a coded message arrives from an unknown sender
exciting.goal: decode it before the final train leaves
exciting.obstacle: the clues point to people they trust
exciting.turn: The truth does not need permission.
exciting.ending: The sender is revealed as their future self.
exciting.final_line: The next clue is already on its way.

hopeful.inciting: a tiny signal reaches Earth from a forgotten satellite
hopeful.goal: answer it before the satellite loses power
hopeful.opening: Someone out there is still listening.
hopeful.obstacle: the signal contains a map of a place that no longer exists
hopeful.action: sends a message built from a childhood song
hopeful.turn: Maybe being heard starts with speaking anyway.
hopeful.ending: A second signal answers from beyond the stars.

exciting.inciting: the station loses gravity during a rescue drill
exciting.opening: That was not part of the drill.
exciting.obstacle: the navigation system has only one working minute
exciting.action: manually pilots through the debris field
exciting.turn: Hold on. We are going home.
exciting.ending: The station stabilizes as the planet rises behind it.
